title: Prove one-column completion over composite cyclotomic alphabets
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with exact finite corroboration. A partial Butson matrix A with n rows, n-1 orthogonal columns and entries among the mth roots of unity has normalized missing column

```text
w = (nI-AA*)e_1, w_1=1
[A w]*[A w] = nI
```

The completion retains the original alphabet for every even m and n>=2, and every odd prime-power m and n>=3. For arbitrary odd m it uses at most the 2mth roots. The two-row input (1,1)^T proves the odd-alphabet dimension restriction is necessary.

This extends David Ganz's prime-order atlas B097 in #2849 and the prime pilot interface in #2855. The new step uses cyclotomic integrality and classical Kronecker theory; it does not audit or replay either predecessor. Classical number theory and matrix families retain credit. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Only `research/cyclotomic-column-completion/` is added. The selected frontier is unchanged.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19214393). Base is canonical main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result.

## Evidence

Before, B097's proof and the pilot implementation cover prime order. After, PROOF.md gives the composite-alphabet implication with arbitrary matrix order under the stated hypotheses.

- All 314 dephased inputs in ten exact small domains pass. The census enumerates 3,879 candidate columns and 2,582 candidate matrices.
- Another 189 gauged tensor-Fourier erasures agree with independently retained missing columns. There are 32 one-parameter family erasures and four odd-alphabet two-row boundary examples.
- Total: 539 completions and 3,325 recovered entries, including 488 cases covered by the same-alphabet theorem. Nine malformed inputs reject and three output mutations fail the Gram oracle.
- Both warning-strict normal and optimized direct/registered commands pass on CPython 3.12.15, standard library only. The registered argv checks were timed locally at 0.117 s and 0.122 s, each below its 60-second limit. These are check durations, not performance comparisons.
- Metadata, six-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity, and normal/optimized read-only Git-free export replays pass at `a3f2b8f53dd4d31912254d40e578df8f63ed7164`. All seven exported files remain unchanged. Generated receipts bind the package files by SHA256.
- Syntax and function-size inspection pass; the longest function is 26 lines. Managed-runtime allocation and dispatch deviations are documented.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/cyclotomic-column-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/cyclotomic-column-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cyclotomic-column-completion
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cyclotomic-column-completion --check-source-history
```

Expected markers are `PASS_CYCLOTOMIC_COLUMN_COMPLETION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Any CPython 3.12 path may replace the local path.

## Limitations

This is a scoped algebraic proof with finite corroboration. More than one erased column, noisy data, physical preparation, paid consumption, dirty restoration, stock/precision/tape costs and supplier admission are unproved. No new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human/formal proof-kernel review and global literature priority are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay were not run. The cheap selected source-binding orientation passed and is metadata evidence only.

## Open next questions

1. Does original-alphabet completion also hold for odd composite m and n>=3? Start with m=15 in a dimension permitting mixed 3-cycle and 5-cycle vanishing sums. A root sum alone is insufficient; the candidate must be a full valid partial matrix.
2. Can the exact column formula give a certified noisy-input repair? Start with a perturbation bound and a root-rounding separation radius. Exact orthogonality and integrality remain the blocker here.

## Related open work

This account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM were refreshed before DONE. The two other new contributions study different quantities:

- [#5866](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5866) classifies binary orthogonal-chart phase defects under a fixed-subspace constraint. It does not study missing columns over complex cyclotomic alphabets.
- [#5867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5867) counts finite-field connector repair ranks and minimum-rank chart density. It does not study the one-column alphabet-completion quantity.

Their titles and bodies were read. Neither computes a numerical value shared by this package; no additional computation was run to check their results. No open PR studying this one-column cyclotomic completion/alphabet quantity was found in the overlap searches. Merged #2849 and #2855 are the direct predecessors. Sparse local-note coverage is incomplete, and the searches do not cover unpublished work.

## CI notes

At contribution commit `a3f2b8f53dd4d31912254d40e578df8f63ed7164`, [Registered research packages run 40486181662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40486181662) failed in `plan`, specifically the **Onboarding helper tests** step. The log identifies `tests/test_research_current_assignment.py` and ends `Ran 511 tests` / `FAILED (failures=8, errors=2, skipped=22)`. The two errors are `KeyError: 'follow_up_steps'` and `KeyError: 'catalog_first_step'`; the eight failed assertions are in the same test file.

All ten failure entries were compared with [#5854's run 40478863245](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40478863245) and match exactly. Both contributions use main base `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. This confirms the reported shared onboarding failure. Maintainers will repair it; no shared tests or file outside this package were changed.

The `replay` job was **skipped**. **Hosted replay has not certified this package; only local scientific checks have run.** Local normal/optimized direct and registered checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight, export integrity and both read-only Git-free replays passed as recorded above. The mathematical result and package files are unchanged after publication.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated research package. No shared executable, pinned source or selected record changes.
